column1: # One row per GWAS used for colocalisation. Lines starting with # are ignored.
#   name      short label used in output file names (letters, digits, _ only)
#   path      summary statistics file (TSV, may be gzipped)
#   snp_col, bp_col, beta_col, se_col, p_col   column names in that file
#   n_col     column holding per-SNP sample size (leave empty to use n)
#   n         total sample size when there is no n_col
#   s         proportion of cases, required when type is cc
# SNP IDs must use the same naming (e.g. rsIDs) as the genotype VCF.
